events.why: record storm; the wettest calendar day in the 311-era record at Midway. Rain was far heavier on the West Side and near-west suburbs than at either climate station.
second-wettest two-station day in the record; falls three days after another 3.5 in event, so antecedent wetness is unusually high.
second August 2026 event; the small end of the range.
